info.name: Gatehold (local MiniStack)
info.description:
Import with Gatehold.postman_environment.json.
Select Gatehold MiniStack → Desktop Agent.

Folders: Health, Holds, Orders, Saga logs, Domain events, Mock payment. Variants under Examples.

API flow: Hold seats → Accept order → Get seat (PAYING → SOLD after saga) → Saga logs / Domain events.
Mock payment: compose service on :8090 (or go run). Health → Authorize → Capture|Void → Refund → Status.
Phase 8: after confirm, Domain events → stream-relay + logger logs + List notify SQS messages.

request.description: Reserve seats (HELD). Saves holdId + seatIds for Accept order. See Examples for group/conflict/400.
Buy an existing hold. Run Holds → Hold seats first (sets holdId + seatIdsJson). Idempotency-Key required. Examples: retry / 400 / 409.

item.name: Saga logs

request.description:
CloudWatch Logs FilterLogEvents against MiniStack for gatehold-dev-verify-hold.
Look for `verify-hold ok` (success) or `verify-hold failed` / VerifyHoldError.
Equivalent curl:
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4566/ -H 'Content-Type: application/x-amz-json-1.1' -H 'X-Amz-Target: Logs_20140328.FilterLogEvents' -d '{"logGroupName":"/aws/lambda/gatehold-dev-verify-hold","filterPattern":"verify-hold","limit":20}' | jq -r '.events[].message'

item.description: Purchase saga Lambda logs via MiniStack CloudWatch. After Accept order, wait a few seconds then filter.

item.name: Domain events
item.description: Phase 8 observe after MarkConfirmed: stream-relay → EventBridge → logger Lambda (8b) + SNS → notify SQS (8c). MiniStack EB→CW Logs targets do not deliver.

request.description: CloudWatch Logs for gatehold-dev-stream-relay. Expect `OrderConfirmed candidate` then `OrderConfirmed published`.
EventBridge rule target is order-confirmed-logger Lambda (not CW Logs — MiniStack does not deliver EB→Logs). Expect `OrderConfirmed received` with detail JSON.
Phase 8c — after confirm, expect a message on gatehold-dev-order-notifications (SNS envelope; Message = EventBridge OrderConfirmed JSON). Order accept queue may also appear. No consumer until 8d.
Emulator readiness. events/dynamodbstreams/logs/sns/sqs/ses should be available for Phase 8.
After saga success, status should be CONFIRMED. Uses orderId saved by Accept order.
Smoke the local go/mock-payment process (go run ./mock-payment from go/). Not the API Gateway health.

Reserve funds (does not capture). Saves paymentAuthId + paymentStatusKey. Then Capture or Void. For chaos, use Authorize (chaos) or Examples with X-Chaos-Force. Content-Type application/json required.

response.name: 409 conflict different body
timeout chaos then use Status
response.body: (empty body — outcome stored; GET Status with pay:auth:{{paymentOrderId}})

exec: console.warn('Set chaosForce env to 429, 500, 502, timeout, or latency');
// timeout chaos: empty body but store may have accepted — run Status next

request.description: Same as Authorize but sends X-Chaos-Force from env chaosForce (429 | 500 | 502 | timeout | latency). For timeout: body may be empty; run Status with paymentStatusKey. Set CHAOS_TIMEOUT_MS=1 on the server for a fast timeout smoke.
Capture a prior authorization. Run Authorize first. Sets paymentStatusKey to pay:capture:…. Happy path: Authorize → Capture.

response.name: 409 invalid transition

request.description: Cancel an authorization (no money moved). Run Authorize first. Alternative to Capture when seats cannot be confirmed.

response.name: 409 already captured

request.description: Return captured funds. Run Authorize → Capture first. Requires CAPTURED.

response.name: 409 not captured yet

request.description: Look up outcome by any operation idempotency key. Authorize/Capture/Void/Refund scripts set paymentStatusKey. After X-Chaos-Force: timeout on Authorize, call Status with pay:auth:{orderId}.
